claimBoundary: Shared-runner average-time ratchet. The v3 decision authority preserves and content-binds the frozen v2 benchmark inventory and finite family thresholds. A material regression is established only when the JMH point estimate minus its reported scoreError remains above the configured maximum. A point estimate above the maximum whose uncertainty overlaps the boundary is INCONCLUSIVE and fails closed rather than being reported as a pass. Low-precision measurements below the maximum remain diagnostic and are not evidence of stable performance. The authority does not establish cross-hardware absolute performance or statistical significance beyond the recorded JMH uncertainty.
